name: DEATH TO EERICK: THE PROLOGUE
source:
Eerick Yaku, a magnet for misfortune, navigates a series of dire situations within the confines of Flower Hospital. Trapped within its walls, his ultimate goal is to escape alive. However, the misfortune doesn't end there – even a seemingly routine job interview can turn fatal!

Can you guide Eerick through this perilous journey, ensuring his survival until the very end?
